name: Hokuryū (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Hokuryū town emblem in white: a slanted rectangle of interlocking strokes forming a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Hokuryū, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 23 July 1963.

features.role: Hokuryū town emblem — a slanted rectangle of interlocking strokes forming a stylised character
